mainEntity.name: How does GOE differ from paid advertising (PPC) for contractors?

acceptedAnswer.text: GOE differs from paid advertising (PPC) primarily in its approach to visibility and cost structure. GOE focuses on achieving organic, non-paid rankings through SEO, building long-term authority and traffic that doesn't cease when you stop paying. PPC, conversely, involves paying for ad placements at the top of search results. While PPC offers immediate visibility, costs are incurred per click or impression, and visibility disappears when the campaign budget is exhausted. GOE is a sustained investment; PPC is a continuous expenditure.
acceptedAnswer.description: GOE focuses on achieving organic, non-paid search rankings for long-term visibility, while paid advertising (PPC) involves paying for immediate ad placements that cease when the budget runs out.
